title: Research Assistant prompt forbids undeveloped mouse/keyboard and code-write capabilities
description:
Expected: Research Assistant primary prompt should describe only implemented behavior and real governance boundaries. It must not warn users that the assistant is forbidden from using mouse/keyboard control or writing code when those capabilities are not implemented.

Actual: The enabled root assistant prompt includes `禁止控制鼠标键盘，禁止写代码`, and `/health` exposes runtime boundaries such as `mouse_keyboard_control=false` and `code_write=false`. This makes the product appear to forbid unavailable capabilities rather than simply describing the supported MCP/API/approval workflow.

Evidence:
- `backend/services/research_assistant/service.py:281` hardcodes `禁止控制鼠标键盘，禁止写代码` in `DEFAULT_PROMPT_NODES[root.assistant]`.
- The live `GET /api/v1/research-assistant/prompt-nodes?status=enabled&limit=500` response was reported to return the same text for `root.assistant`.
- `backend/services/research_assistant/service.py:505-506` exposes `mouse_keyboard_control=false` and `code_write=false` in `/health` runtime boundaries.

Closure requirements:
1. Remove `禁止控制鼠标键盘` and `禁止写代码` from the Research Assistant root prompt source.
2. Backfill/update the current DB `assistant_prompt_nodes.root.assistant` record so live chat no longer uses the stale text.
3. Replace negative unavailable-capability metadata (`mouse_keyboard_control=false`, `code_write=false`) with a positive implemented-capability summary or remove it from user-facing health payloads.
4. Keep real governance boundaries: high-risk operations still require MCP/API, approval, traceability, and memory/audit discipline.
5. Add/update backend tests proving the root prompt and live prompt-node listing do not contain those two forbidden undeveloped-capability phrases.
reproduce_command: cd F:\Dev\AIstock && rg -n "禁止控制鼠标键盘|禁止写代码|mouse_keyboard_control|code_write" backend\services\research_assistant\service.py
required_verification: Static grep confirms the root prompt no longer contains `禁止控制鼠标键盘` or `禁止写代码`.
Live prompt-node listing for `root.assistant` no longer contains those phrases after DB backfill.
Health/runtime capability payload describes implemented capabilities positively or omits unavailable capability booleans.
Prompt governance boundaries still require MCP/API, approval, trace and memory/audit discipline.
closure_requirements: Prompt source and live DB prompt-node record are both updated.
Unavailable mouse/keyboard and code-write capability bans are not user-facing.
Tests cover root prompt source and prompt-node listing.
non_goals: Do not implement mouse/keyboard control in this issue.
Do not implement code-writing capability in Research Assistant chat in this issue.
Do not weaken MCP/API approval, traceability, or audit boundaries.
